integration_rules: Never calculate catalog_hint_only, official_preview_only, historical_official_qualitative or unverified records as current numeric fact.
Distinguish shield_generation, shield_restoration, shield_capacity, and shield mitigation.
Process trigger_duplication without emitting a second Frost Vortex or re-entering its own trigger.
A None magnitude is unknown, not zero.
Set thresholds are cumulative; count distinct equipped pieces belonging to that set, never duplicate a slot.
An official release establishes the listed behavior at release, but null magnitudes or missing curves remain uncomputed. Surface partial contributions and intervals rather than inventing totals.
The Bastille two-piece bonus is Reload Efficiency +15% as of January 2026, not the old Reload Speed +20%; their conversion varies by weapon type.
Do not use 2024 historical gear or Bastille threshold parameters as current 2026 fact without later tooltip confirmation.
community_snapshot_candidate rows are arithmetic scenarios only, with a March 2026 source-age label. Never silently blend them into a verified October 2026 result.
For conditional, stack and decay rules, execute only dimensions with known trigger inputs; keep unknown curves, rounding, durations or target counts as unresolved intervals or annotations.
numeric_candidate is separate, opt-in community database evidence. It must not inherit the official binding status of its parent threshold.
changelog_v2: Promoted Dark Resonance 1–4, Gilded Gauntlets, Pivot-Step Boots, Snowdrift Top and Bloodstained Tracker Boots from preview to confirmed released behavior; magnitudes remain unknown where null.
Bound Bastille 2-piece Reload Efficiency +15% from the January 2026 official release.
Added historical official 2024 Bastille 1/3/4 state/stack/shield descriptors, and Desert Dust Mask/Tattoo Pants proc descriptors, explicitly gated against current calculation.
Kept Treacherous Tides 4-piece 30% shield and 8-second cooldown as preview-only: later release confirms enhancement but not its numbers.
changelog_v3: Added 63 exact-wording, March 2026 community-snapshot set bindings; each is opt-in as an assumption scenario.
Attached 14 live community database numeric candidates for Savior, Treacherous Tides, Dark Resonance and Bastille while preserving official evidence classes.
Did not infer standalone gear magnitudes or hidden level scaling from catalog identity rows.
